description: This file contains a single exported function `shapeStackedSeries` that processes an array of cost records into a dataset suitable for stacked charts, with zero-filling for missing categories. It includes detailed handling of options, sorting, and categorization.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms cost records into a dataset formatted for stacked chart visualization, grouping by a specified key and filling missing categories with zero.
